table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + 'Counter Sale'   else item.name end,
	reprintdate=getdate(), 
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	headerno =max(saleorderheader.headerno),
	posted=max(saleorderheader.posted),
	dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode,   
	date=dbo.saleorderheader.date,   
	discperc=dbo.saleorderheader.discperc,   
	misccharges=dbo.saleorderheader.misccharges,   
	flatdisc=dbo.saleorderheader.flatdisc,   
	salestax=0.00,   
	custcode=dbo.saleorderheader.custcode,   
	remarks=dbo.saleorderheader.remarks,
	custrefno=dbo.saleorderheader.custrefno,	
	icode=dbo.saleorderdetail.icode,   
	gcode=dbo.saleorderdetail.gcode,
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saleorderdetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(saleorderdetail.looseqty), 
	packunits = max(saleorderdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saleorderdetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saleorderdetail.rate),
	salestax  = 0,   
	discperc  = max(saleorderdetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saleorderdetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saleorderdetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saleorderdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleorderheader.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleorderheader.reprintingcounter),
	serverdate=getdate(),
	balance=0,
	amt = max(dbo.saleorderheader.amt)
FROM 
	dbo.saleorderheader,   
	dbo.saleorderdetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 

WHERE 
	( dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode = :ra_Code ) AND
	( dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode = dbo.saleorderdetail.saleordercode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleorderheader.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleorderheader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( saleorderdetail.icode = item.icode )  

GROUP BY 
	saleorderheader.saleordercode, 
	saleorderheader.date, 
	saleorderheader.custcode, 
	saleorderheader.discperc, 
	saleorderheader.flatdisc, 
	saleorderheader.misccharges, 
	saleorderheader.remarks,
	saleorderheader.custrefno, 
	saleorderdetail.icode,
	saleorderdetail.rowgroup, 
	saleorderdetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
	MAX(dbo.saleorderdetail.IDENTITYCOL)
